scope: Durable paper lifecycle requests and native observations, separate from trade databases

tests.transition_tests: mocked native RPC only; no actual lifecycle actions

behavior: A request is logged before native activation; fresh state/profile is required to report the requested state as observed.
History storage failure prevents new activation, but does not block native pause/stop or erase confirmed native state.
History read/storage errors remain separate from worker connectivity/execution state.
Records persist in a separate SQLite file; stable descending-ID pagination and profile/strategy filtering.
limitations: No backfill of prior sessions. The first real event is the current stopped baseline.
No inferred runtime duration or per-session P&L; unobserved external transitions may be absent.
The local journal is not a tamper-proof audit log.
